text: You might enjoy this Oven Roasted Broccoli recipe as it's quick, easy, and packed with nutrients. The 15-minute cooking time fits within your 30-minute time budget, and the ingredients are relatively simple. Broccoli is a versatile vegetable that pairs well with a variety of tastes, so it's hard to go wrong with this dish. The addition of parmesan cheese adds a rich flavor, while the garlic and red pepper flakes provide a subtle kick. Overall, this recipe is a straightforward and satisfying option that should suit your needs.
